subject: Proposal: Maya Labs accelerator pilot — promo credit allocation & invoicing cadence
messages:
From: Maya Labs <maya@mayalabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: accelerator pilot + expected usage

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking a look — we run a 12-week accelerator (cohort of ~8 teams) and are evaluating inference partners for model-powered demos, embeddings for search, and a small fine-tune for one team. Typical peak is ~150 requests/min with many short chats and a few long-gen jobs (~1k-2k tokens).

Two asks:
- Is there a promotional package for cohorts (credits or trial top-up)?
- Can credits be applied to a single consolidated instructor account or must they be per-team?

Procurement will also be involved on any contract. Looping them in next.

Thanks,
Maya Ford
Program Lead, Maya Labs
maya@mayalabs.com

---
(Attachment: accelerator_scope.csv (text/csv) referenced)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Labs <maya@mayalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: accelerator pilot + expected usage

Hi Maya — great to meet you over email and congrats on the new cohort. Short answers up front: yes, we can offer a cohort promotional credit and we can apply credits at the instructor (consolidated) level with usage allocation rules.

What I propose (based on the profile you provided):
- One-time promotional credit: $3,000 equivalent (applied as 1.2M token-credit) front-loaded to the instructor account.
- Billing: net-30 monthly invoicing for any consumption beyond credits.
- Packaging: a single instructor account with sub-accounts for each team (visibility + per-team quotas).

If procurement needs different cadence we can be flexible, but I wanted to get a baseline on the table. I attached a draft SOW (SOW-MayALabs-v2.pdf) and a quick CSV that maps credit draw rules (Promo_Terms.csv) so you can forward to your operations and procurement folks.

Next steps: if that sounds reasonable, procurement can send PO or we can prepare a 12-month order form with a conditional discount if you commit to a 12-month consumption floor.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: SOW-MayALabs-v2.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: Promo_Terms.csv (text/csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Maya Labs <maya@mayalabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: accelerator pilot + expected usage

Adding ops notes:
- Promo credits can be consumed by sub-accounts; they’ll appear on consolidated billing but we can push breakouts per sub-account in the monthly invoice CSV.
- Credits expire 90 days from issue unless we mark them as cohort-locked (we can extend to 180 days for this case).
- If you want per-team caps, we’ll surface alerts when a team hits 80% of its quota.

Maya — I can run a quick walkthrough of the console with your instructor accounts this week if that helps procurement sign off faster.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

---
(Attachment referenced: onboarding_guide.md (text/markdown) — internal only)

From: procurement@mayalabs.com
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Maya Labs accelerator pilot — promo credit allocation & invoicing cadence

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the proposal. Procurement here — a couple of constraints from finance and legal that will shape the final form:
1) We need credits to be amortized over 12 months on our books (cannot be fully front-loaded for accounting reasons). Can you split the $3,000 credit as 12 monthly allocations (250/mo) even if issued upfront?
2) We require vendor invoices on a monthly net-30 cadence and prefer a single consolidated invoice for the instructor account.
3) Is there a mechanism to cap our monthly spend to avoid overruns (notify + auto-throttle)?

Attached is a preliminary PO (PO-7891.pdf) — this is to reserve the promo while we finish procurement approval. If you can confirm amortization and the cap/auto-throttle, we can move to signatures.

Regards,
Ethan Ford
Procurement Manager, Maya Labs
procurement@mayalabs.com

[Attachment: PO-7891.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@mayalabs.com>, Maya Labs <maya@mayalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-04T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Maya Labs accelerator pilot — promo credit allocation & invoicing cadence

Ethan — appreciate the clarity and the PO. We can accommodate the three items you raised:

1) Amortization: We will issue the full $3,000 promotional credit up front but annotate it in your billing as 12 monthly allocations of $250 for accounting. The credit balance will be visible immediately; the invoice CSV will include the amortized line items to match your GL.

2) Consolidated invoice: Confirmed — single instructor-level invoice, with optional per-team breakout CSV attached to the invoice for internal allocation. Net-30 standard.

3) Cap/auto-throttle: We can set a hard spend cap at the instructor level and configure an auto-throttle that reduces model concurrency once the cap is reached; notifications to the owner and procurement will be sent at 80% and 95% thresholds. We’ll also enable an override path if you want to increment the cap mid-month.

Proposal for final commercial concession (accepting PO-7891 as reservation):
- Promo: $3,000 credit (amortized 12 months in your invoice CSV).
- Billing: monthly net-30 consolidated invoice.
- One conditional concession: if you sign a 12-month committed-consumption order form within 30 days we’ll apply a 20% discount to standard per-token rates for the first 12 months.

I’ve attached an updated SOW (SOW-MayALabs-v2.pdf) and the Promo_Terms.csv with the amortization and throttle rules filled in. If that aligns, I’ll push the order form to DocuSign and ask legal to accept the amortization language.

Next steps:
- You sign PO-7891 to reserve promos (received).
- We’ll send DocuSign with order form + amortization clause (link below).
- On signature we’ll provision credits and instructor/sub-account structure.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/REDW-MAYA-2025
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-2024-98765

Thanks — excited to get Maya Labs onboarded.

Best,
Jonas Weber
